title: Rapid mitigation for customer-visible latency spikes: connection hold and retry policy update
creator: Ethan Green
description: Summary: A subset of high-throughput tenants experienced sudden latency spikes followed by cascading 5xx errors during aggressive SDK client retries. The visible customer symptom: generation requests hanging for >5s then returning 502/504 with multiple duplicate logs per user request. Scope: Hosted API (gateway -> proxy -> combiner -> model workers). Impact window first observed 2026-03-09 22:40 UTC and recurred in smaller bursts through 2026-03-10. Root cause hypothesis: combination of (1) connection-hold behavior in proxy layer when downstream workers had slow KV cache misses, and (2) SDKs issuing parallel retries without idempotency token amplification, causing connection exhaustion and request duplication. Immediate customer escalations received from two enterprise tenants (legal-regulated workloads).
comments: 2026-03-10 03:10 - Ethan Green: Triage call summary: attach request traces and tenant rate profiles. Suspect proxy connection hold + retry amplification. Kick off hotpatch working group.
2026-03-10 05:45 - Sarah Liu: Uploaded sample traces to dashboard (link below). Observed many inflight requests per connection, long tail at combiner layer at 300-600ms beyond normal.

2026-03-11 09:00 - Diego Morales: Implemented conservative proxy connection timeout patch (PR #1209) to close stale held connections sooner and avoid head-of-line blocking. Canary deployed to 5% to low-risk tenants.

2026-03-12 14:20 - Sarah Liu: Canary metrics look promising: median latency down 18% for canary tenants, 5xx rate reduced by 60% in canary. No regressions in throughput. Preparing wider rollout and SDK guidance.
2026-03-13 11:35 - Priya Nair (Support): Customer comms drafted for affected tenants with mitigation steps and timeline. Legal/compliance review approved message for enterprise customers.

2026-03-13 16:40 - Ethan Green: Rolling out proxy patch to Dedicated and Private control planes with the same config toggle. Monitoring enabled for connection saturation and retry amplification signs.
action_items: Hotpatch proxy: reduce connection hold window from 30s -> 3s for suspected KV-miss paths (PR #1209)
Backoff policy: update server-side gate to reject immediate duplicate requests without idempotency token, return 429 where appropriate
SDK guidance: publish short-term recommended retry semantics (exponential backoff, jitter, idempotency token usage) and include in release notes
Instrument combiner to expose per-tenant inflight-request histogram and top 20 tenant maps
Engage L4 on-call for 48h monitoring post-rollout and prepare runbook for rapid rollback
rollback_plan: If global 95th latency increases >10% or 5xx regression >5% on post-rollout within 30 minutes, revert proxy config to previous values via feature-flag rollback. For Dedicated/private, run controlled rollback with customer opt-in communicated via account teams.
postmortem_notes: Need clearer invariant: proxy should never accept unlimited retries without tenant-level concurrency limit
Improve cross-team observable: link SDK retry graphs to infra traces for faster root-cause correlation
Add automated test simulating KV-cache miss with concurrent SDK retries to CI perf suite
Formalize escalation playbook: next time label incident as CUSTOMER-ESCALATION and route PM/SEs directly
monitoring_checks: Alert: proxy_held_connections_avg > 50 for any proxy instance
SLOs: monitor P95 latency and compare canary vs baseline every 5m
